findings.current: If Song Cheonwoo’s voice had been swallowed by the howling blizzard, that loyal servant would have rushed over and tried to kill the traitor.
findings.defect: The condition is reversed. The source says Butler Kim would have attacked if the blizzard had not drowned out Song Cheonwoo’s voice.
findings.rationale: The explicit negation in 파묻히지 않았다면 is essential to the mechanics of why the distant Butler Kim has not intervened.
findings.replacement: Had Song Cheonwoo’s voice not been swallowed by the howling blizzard, that loyal servant would have flown over and tried to kill the traitor.
findings.source: 맹렬하게 몰아치는 눈보라에 송천우의 목소리가 파묻히지 않았다면, 나는 듯이 달려와 배신자를 죽이려 들었을 충복이었다.

findings.current: And that loyalty was passed down in its entirety to a life born after the war ended.
findings.defect: “Passed down” suggests that the child inherited Hwa-jong’s loyalty. The source says Hwa-jong extended the same undiminished devotion to the child.
findings.rationale: 그 마음 refers to Hwa-jong’s loyal heart, while 이어졌지 describes that devotion continuing toward Choi Minwoo rather than being inherited by him.
findings.replacement: And he gave that same loyalty, whole and undiminished, to a life born after the war ended.
findings.source: 그리고 그 마음은 종전(終戰) 이후 태어난 한 생명에게 고스란히 이어졌지.

findings.current: “Even on the day when everything changed, his most loyal aide was at your side.”
findings.defect: The pronoun “his” has the young child as its nearest antecedent, obscuring the source’s explicit statement that Hwa-jong was Cheon Taemin’s most loyal aide.
findings.rationale: 그분 refers reverentially to Cheon Taemin; the relationship matters because Song is explaining how Cheon Taemin’s loyal retainer came to protect Choi Minwoo.
findings.replacement: “Even on the day everything changed, your grandfather’s most loyal aide was at your side.”
findings.source: 모든 것이 달라진 그 날에도, 그분의 가장 충실한 심복은 네 곁에 있었다.

findings.current:
“You managed to survive through all that, Director Song. What a tenacious life.”

Song Cheonwoo answered in a powerless voice, his tone cuttingly sarcastic.
findings.defect: The narration wrongly attributes the cutting sarcasm to Song Cheonwoo rather than Choi Minwoo. It also flattens Choi’s pointed use of Song’s regional-director title.
findings.rationale: 최민우의 신랄한 어조 identifies Choi’s preceding line as sarcastic, while Song answers 무력한 목소리로, in a weak or helpless voice.
findings.replacement:
“You managed to survive all that, Regional Director. You really are tenacious.”

Song Cheonwoo answered Choi Minwoo’s cutting sarcasm in a feeble voice.
findings.source:
“그 와중에 지사장님은 용케 살아남으셨군요. 참으로 질긴 목숨입니다.”

최민우의 신랄한 어조에 송천우가 무력한 목소리로 대답했다.

findings.current: A yeti’s roar echoed from somewhere, as though voicing Choi Minwoo’s feelings for him.
findings.defect: “For him” adds Song Cheonwoo as the specific object of Choi’s feelings, whereas the source only says the roar seemed to express Choi’s emotional state.
findings.rationale: 심정을 대신하다 conveys giving voice to his feelings generally and does not specify an object.
findings.replacement: A yeti’s roar echoed from somewhere, as though voicing Choi Minwoo’s feelings.
findings.source: 어디선가 들려오는 예티의 포효가 최민우의 심정을 대신하는 듯했다.

findings.current: “But I do not know exactly where he is being kept. For now, Area A is the only possibility.”
findings.defect: The draft converts a tentative suspicion into an exclusive conclusion.
findings.rationale: 의심될 뿐이지 means that Area A is only suspected; it does not state that every other possibility has been eliminated.
findings.replacement: “But I do not know exactly where he is being kept. For now, I merely suspect Area A.”

findings.current: The moment Choi Minwoo realized that Song Cheonwoo’s gaze had fallen on his hand, the old man continued in a quiet voice.
findings.defect: “Realized” turns Choi’s subjective impression into certainty.
findings.rationale: 느낀 preserves Choi’s perception without confirming that Song was definitively looking at his hand.
findings.replacement: The moment Choi Minwoo felt Song Cheonwoo’s gaze settle on his hand, the old man continued in a quiet voice.
findings.source: 최민우가 그의 시선이 자신의 손을 향했다고 느낀 순간, 나직한 목소리가 이어졌다.

summary: One critical negation reversal, several relationship and epistemic distortions, and localized attribution and wording issues.
